rationale: Ground truth shows this was a trivial, well-tested bound change with unanimous LGTM and no real concerns, so neither review had much to 'recall.' X's review hinges almost entirely on three 'blocking' findings about specific line numbers and code content in reliability test files that are nowhere in the diff and are asserted with high confidence but no visible evidence trail, making them hard to trust and a real fabrication risk. Y's findings (missing positive test for the new layers=2 minimum, thin docstring) are modest but directly grounded in the shown diff/files, verifiable, and Y shows its grep/sweep evidence transparently, giving it much stronger precision even though its findings are lower-stakes and less actionable than X's specific line-and-fix suggestions.
